Deja Vu I & II - The Casebooks of Ace Ha.name: Déjà Vu I & II: The Casebooks of Ace Harding
Deja Vu I & II - The Casebooks of Ace Ha.summary:
Take on two thrilling mysteries in one Game Pak!

Life is never boring when you assume the role of Ace Harding, private detective. In Deja Vu I, you will scramble down the dark alleys of Chicago, searching for a cure for you amnesia and a killer who has framed you for a brutal murder. After solving the first case, you'll uncover a few loose strings that gradually unrabel into Deja Vu II. Trapped in the slimy town of Last Vegas, you find yourself dealing with a notorious mob leader who makes you an offer you can't refuse.

-Two detailed graphic adventure games in one Game Boy Color Game Pak!
-Detailed commands for interacting with anyone or anything!
-Return to the scene of the crime, or any of the other 140 locations!
-Sort out the real evidence from the red herrings and over 80 other items!
-Battery-backed save option for up to three save game files!

Kero Kero Cowboy.name: Kero Kero Cowboy
Kero Kero Cowboy.summary: Kero Kero Cowboy is a brand new western themed platformer for the Game Boy Color! You play as Kero Kero, a frog on a journey to wrangle the wild west's most dangerous outlaws & bring peace to the untamed land. Face dastardly foes, perilous platforming challenges, and intense shootouts across deserts, mines, mountains, trains, forests, and beyond!

Star Wars Episode I - Racer.name: Star Wars: Episode I - Racer
Star Wars Episode I - Racer.summary: Star Wars: Episode 1 - Racer lets you participate in the famous pod race sequence that was the critical highlight of the 1999 film Star Wars: Episode I, The Phantom Menace. These lightning-quick vehicles are capable of reaching simulated speeds of up to 600 miles per hour while skimming a mere 4 feet above the ground. The Game Boy Color version of the game is a top-down racer that faces you against one other rival podracer, in single player or multiplayer with a link cable.

Yu-Gi-Oh! - Monster Capsule GB.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Monster Capsule GB
Yu-Gi-Oh! - Monster Capsule GB.summary: Yu-Gi-Oh! Monster Capsule GB is a video game for the Game Boy Color. It has only been released in Japan. The game takes most of its inspiration from the manga's Monster World story arc and the Capsule Monsters stories, using both Duel Monsters and Capsule Monsters.
